name: LubeLogger
tagline: Vehicle Maintenance and Fuel Mileage Tracker.
description:
![image](https://github.com/hargata/lubelog/assets/155338622/545debcd-d80a-44da-b892-4c652ab0384a)

Self-Hosted, Open-Source, Web-Based Vehicle Maintenance and Fuel Mileage Tracker

Website: https://lubelogger.com

## Why
Because nobody should have to deal with a homemade spreadsheet or a shoebox full of receipts when it comes to vehicle maintenance.

## Showcase
[Promotional Brochure](https://lubelogger.com/brochure.pdf)

[Screenshots](/docs/screenshots.md)

## Demo
Try it out before you download it! The live demo resets every 20 minutes.

[Live Demo](https://demo.lubelogger.com) Login using username "test" and password "1234"

### Need Help?
[Documentation](https://docs.lubelogger.com/)

[Troubleshooting Guide](https://docs.lubelogger.com/Troubleshooting)

[Search Existing Issues](https://github.com/hargata/lubelog/issues)

## Dependencies
- [Bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap)
- [LiteDB](https://github.com/mbdavid/litedb)
- [Npgsql](https://github.com/npgsql/npgsql)
- [Bootstrap-DatePicker](https://github.com/uxsolutions/bootstrap-datepicker)
- [SweetAlert2](https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2)
- [CsvHelper](https://github.com/JoshClose/CsvHelper)
- [Chart.js](https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js)
- [Drawdown](https://github.com/adamvleggett/drawdown)
- [MailKit](https://github.com/jstedfast/MailKit)

## License
MIT

## Support
Support this project by [Subscribing on Patreon](https://patreon.com/LubeLogger) or [Making a Donation](https://buy.stripe.com/aEU9Egc8DdMc9bO144)

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Locale and Language Settings
questions.hint: Affect how numbers, currencies, and dates are formatted.

questions.label: Allowed File Extensions
questions.hint: Allowed file extensions for document uploads, use '*' to allow all file types.

questions.label: Message of the Day
questions.hint: Message of The Day displayed in Login page if configured.

questions.label: Email > Server
questions.hint: Email SMTP settings used only for configuring multiple users(to send their registration token and forgot password tokens).

questions.label: Auth > Enable ?
questions.hint: Allows users to configure whether if authentication is enabled via environment variable.

questions.label: Auth > Username Hash
questions.hint: SHA256 Hash of the root username.

questions.label: Auth > Password Hash
questions.hint: SHA256 Hash of the root password.

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Name
questions.hint: Name of the OpenID Connect Provider

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Client ID
questions.hint: Client Id to Authenticate with the Provider

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Client Secret
questions.hint: Client Secret to Authenticate with the Provider

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Authorization URL
questions.hint: Authorization URL to the Provider's Login Page

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Token URL
questions.hint: URL to retrieve user JWT from the Provider

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Scope
questions.hint: The scope for retrieving the user's email claim(usually it's just 'email')

questions.label: Auth > OpenID > Validate State
questions.hint: true/false(default: false) - whether LubeLogger should validate state.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.
